title: Penryn Battle Memorial
crew_summary: Crew — details not recorded in source
memorial_details: Plaque to Sgt C.M. Jennings, KIA 11 May 1940, inside St Gluvias Church, Penryn, Cornwall.
narrative: Fairey Battle P2326 of 218 Squadron, coded HA-?, was based with the Advanced Air Striking Force at Auberive-sur-Suippes. On 11 May 1940 the aircraft was hit by ground fire and abandoned over the target. Sgt C.M. Jennings of Penryn, Cornwall is commemorated in St Gluvias Church.
cause_of_loss: Hit by ground fire; crew abandoned aircraft over target

sources.title: Chorley, W.R. — Bomber Command Losses Vol. 1
